sections.section_title: GFXTIM relative frame counter 1 reload register (GFXTIM_RFC1RR)
sections.text_helper: Section 23.5.21 "GFXTIM relative frame counter 1 reload register (GFXTIM_RFC1RR)" in chapter 23 (Graphic timer (GFXTIM)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1112.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x084
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:12 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 11:0 FRAME[11:0]: Frame reload value
Reload value for the relative frame counter 1.
